Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "From spiritual community to a depth psychology PhD", "body": "Sophie Fletcher tells Chance Garton she was raised inside a spiritual community from around age four, a framework she credits with keeping her grounded even as it fed a habit of dissociating into what she calls the dorsal, shut down side of the nervous system. She studied philosophy and psychoanalysis, finished a first master's in spiritual psychology at 24, then met a bodyworker trained in Chinese meridian theory whose wife used human design in her coaching. Human design and somatic work arrived together for her. She later completed a second master's and a PhD in depth psychology with a somatic emphasis at Pacifica Graduate Institute."}, {"title": "The six sciences behind the human design system", "body": "Fletcher reports that human design was transcribed by a man later known as Ra Uru Hu, who said a voice delivered the material to him. He taught it, then told his students to burn everything and disappeared, returning later to rebuild the system from notes the students had quietly kept. As she presents it, the system combines four esoteric sciences, a nine chakra Hindu model, the Kabbalistic tree of life, the I Ching and astrology, with two modern ones, the 64 DNA codons and neutrinos, which she describes as the smallest particles that carry mass and information. She works with tropical rather than sidereal charts."}, {"title": "Five types, five auras, five ways of working", "body": "The body graph, Fletcher explains, sorts people into five types. Generators and manifesting generators are the energy types at roughly 70 percent of the population, defined by a lit up sacral center she likens to an energizer bunny, with an enveloping aura and a strategy of responding rather than initiating. Manifestors are about 8 percent, the only type designed to initiate, carrying a fixed and repelling aura. Projectors, about 20 percent and her own type, have a penetrating aura and are meant to wait for recognition and invitation. Reflectors, about 1 percent, have no defined centers and a sampling aura she says is ruled by the moon."}, {"title": "Authority is the body deciding, not the mind", "body": "Fletcher calls authority the most practical piece of the system, each person's designed route to a decision, and says that in human design nobody at all is built to make a final call from the mind. A defined spleen, she describes, gives one quiet instinctual read that speaks only once. A defined sacral answers in the now through sounds and physical movement, and she has clients practice on low stakes choices like pointing at things in the refrigerator. A defined emotional center trumps the others and gives no clarity in the moment, only clarity over time. Garton, she notes, filters through spleen and sacral to emotional authority."}, {"title": "The emotional wave and the 2027 cycle switch", "body": "Emotional definition, Fletcher says, means living on a wave where a high or a low needs no reason, and the skill is surfing it rather than being crashed around by it. She and Garton share the 37-40 channel running from the emotional center to the ego center, which she calls a ratchet wave that climbs in plateaus then plummets. She contends human design describes roughly 400 year cycles, with the current one switching in 2027 inside the emotional center, and argues emotionally defined people carry the onus of naming their own state honestly. Garton closes by using the system as a diving board into his own intuition."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Blending Divination Disciplines to Better Discern Our Differences...
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: Sophie Fletcher returns to InnerVerse to provide us with an introduction to the syncretic divinatory philosophy of Human Design. We discuss Sophie's education background in various psychological and somatic modalities, the importance of taking your body with you on your spiritual path, the origins of Human Design, how it helps one discover their uniqueness, the different types of people within HD, and examples on how to incorporate the knowledge of your personal style of energetic authority.

fields.Plus Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "The Incarnation Cross and the 2027 Turn", "body": "Sophie opens the members hour on the incarnation cross, the broad stroke life theme drawn from the sun signs in a chart, and explains that humanity is leaving the right angle Cross of Planning for the Cross of the Sleeping Phoenix in 2027. The old tribal energy asked what the group needs so the individual could shape shift to fill it, while the incoming energy asks a person to walk into a group and say plainly who they are. Chance calls the outgoing pattern the messiah op, and Sophie notes the switch lands squarely in the emotional center."}, {"title": "One Channel, Many Esoteric Systems", "body": "Chance reads his own chart aloud and lands on gate 25, the I Ching hexagram of innocence, which he ties to his Aries sun and to the Hebrew letters resh and he. Sophie shows him that 25 belongs to the 25 and 51 channel running from the G center of love to the will center of the heart, and that this was the only channel Ra Uru Hu carried, the very line human design was channeled through. Later they trace gate 61 as inner truth, gate 24 as biting through, and gate 12 as standstill reaching toward the grace of 22."}, {"title": "Designed Differently, Right Down to Mornings", "body": "Sophie tells the story of judging her husband for failing at a morning routine she thrives on, until the charts showed he is literally designed not to have one. She names the moment she caught herself trying to make him be not self, which she calls the whole point of the system. Chance takes it wider, suggesting we are called people because we are all different peoples through which the divine experiences infinity, and that celebrating differentiation rather than enforcing conformity is what actually draws us closer to source consciousness."}, {"title": "The Ladder of Authorities and an Open Mind", "body": "Sophie walks the hierarchy of decision making authorities, from emotional definition that trumps everything, down through sacral, spleen, the will or ego center, and finally the self projected and mental projectors whose authority is their own voice. For those two she recommends voice memos, because the point is hearing your own tone rather than collecting opinions. She also reads Chance's completely open head and ajna as a clear channel built for inspiration to move through, telling him he is designed to stay open to ideas that challenge what he already believed."}, {"title": "Split Definition and Who Links You Up", "body": "Sophie explains single versus split definition, describing a split as two teams inside one body, each with its own opinions, each waiting on the actual authority for clarity. She notes that Chance's gate 22 links up her split while her chart does not link his, and that she deliberately married someone who does not complete hers. Gate 22 is the hexagram of grace, the deepening of enjoyment in simple things, and she traces how growing up around two parents who carried the full channel amplified her sense of having only one gate."}]

fields.Plus Quotes JSON: [{"text": "We're seeing what I think is the thrashing and the last gasps of the previous version of operating.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If everybody sacrifices themself for the group, then the whole group is sacrificed, so that's not going to work anymore.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "We have no idea what's coming down the pipeline after 2027 for the emotional center because none of us have been there yet. But it's mutating. It's definitely shifting.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "One of the things I like about human design is that it flies in the face of a lot of these sort of dogmas.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "I like to think that the reason why we are called people is because we're all different peoples for the divine to experience the infinity through.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Human design is just one of the avenues for self-awareness, and self-exploration, and being yourself.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Now we have a philosophical ground for celebrating our differences rather than trying to stamp them out.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "You're designed to be open-minded. You're designed to be open to new ideas and things that are going to challenge whatever you've previously believed in.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Even though it's the smallest looking center on a chart, the will center, that heart center is a bang of energy.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "When you are interacting with stuck energy in the field, that energy is actually emotion and memory simultaneously.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
fields.Quotes JSON: [{"text": "I had really always been interested in people, like what makes people people, what makes you different than me, what makes certain people make certain choices.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "The body and the mind aren't separate. The body is actually in the mind. It's not the other way around. The body is made up of mind stuff.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "My favorite part of human design is that it's known as the science of differentiation.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's 26 letters in the alphabet, but every story told using those 26 letters is absolutely different and unique with infinite possible variations and permutations.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "If there were more generators on this planet who were taught and encouraged to really go for what they want, like be honest with their answers, we would have a very, very different planet.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "A lot of kids have been trained out of their original noises and taught to say yes or no. Like the phrase of, use your words, say yes or no.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "There's nothing wrong with me that I don't have the same sacral go, go, go energizer bunny as the generator, as my generator husband. I'm literally designed differently.", "author": "Sophie Fletcher", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/cc5dc5bb-2848-4359-9f0a-463178622b47/SOPHIE-FLETCHER.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}, {"text": "Those little incongruent aspects don't matter as much because ultimately we're just using it as a diving board to leap into the well of our own deep inner knowing.", "author": "Chance Garton", "portrait": "https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/5987d897cf81e0278ec5322e/a784fd99-3e6f-436c-a8f3-c4f913b855ed/profile-pic.jpg?content-type=image%2Fjpeg"}]
